summary: Clearwater National Forest L-4 cab on a log crib, built 1934 and abandoned in the 1950s. No remains are described and no source covers the site today.

notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing: four lookout sites plus one forest study whose online copy stops after the introduction and omits the lookout list. Not used: the Forest Lookouts Idaho page lists an October 1920 Kendrick Gazette item (Fly camp, seven miles south of Chamberlain Basin) under the Fly Hill heading; it does not name the peak, so it is not tied to this site. The 1931 staff entry predates the 1934 build; a reviewer may want the Former Forest Fire Lookout Registry entry. Record kind two_story left as is; sources describe an L-4 cab atop a log crib. No photos added. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the Forest Lookouts page lists Fly Hill under Clearwater National Forest and an item dated October 8, 1920; the online study copy stops after its introduction and omits the lookout list; no factual errors found, and three sentences that copied quote wording were reworded.
